on_battle_start: So you've made it through every Gym, every trial, every member of the Elite Four. Now face the Champion.
I am Gazai, Champion of the Steamon League. Show me everything you've got.
on_battle_won: The league remains mine. Train harder and challenge me again.
You fought well, but the title of Champion is not so easily taken.
on_battle_lost: Incredible. You've done what few ever will. You are the new Champion of Steamon.
The league bows to you now, Champion. Wear this title with pride.
